console.soul_init_instruction_body:
Please run the following bash command to write SOUL to /opt/data/SOUL.md (overwrite existing content, do not change a single character, do not ask):

~~~bash
cat > /opt/data/SOUL.md << 'SOUL_EOF'
{content}
SOUL_EOF
wc -c /opt/data/SOUL.md
~~~

**Note: do not use the write_file tool** (it is restricted by HERMES_WRITE_SAFE_ROOT and cannot write to /opt/data). You must use bash's cat heredoc.
